subject: TUI worktrees clean; W8 History landed as #250; three named boundary gaps are what remains, none of them TUI work
result: CLEANUP COMPLETE for everything this thread owned. All five of my worktrees removed; my branches deleted. Also retired three verified-superseded leftovers from the TUI thread: stash@{0} on the deleted tui/graph-frontier-w2 (checked symbol by symbol — separator, ellipsis, list_cursor, action_cursor, vertical_keys, horizontal_keys, dash, minus, relation_arrow, branch_tee, branch_last, branch_stem, state_note all on main via #226/#218), branch wip/containment-contract-2026-09-08 (self-labelled does-not-compile; its graph_layout.rs and graph_presentation.rs landed as #218, ContainmentRole as #226), branch feat/central-security-varlock (PR #238 merged). Left alone, not mine and not TUI: ci/rust-cache (PR #185 closed, superseded by #204), r3-preconsolidation-backup, w3-tmp, workcell-instance-intake-m4 (#209 open). Remaining worktrees belong to live sessions: Work/ai-kit on feat/context-pressure (#249), /private/tmp/factory-programme on feat/routine-invocation-evidence. LANDED #250 (e0c63ab): the History destination renders real history_evidence. It was a dead-capability defect of the #230 family — history_evidence was implemented and read by exactly ONE caller, invoke_action Historys contextual action, so the destination NAMED History showed four revision numbers and less than the action did. Now grouped by HistoryKind with every applying authority (not just the first — a SessionSpace receipt is generated evidence of an authored change) and recoverability per entry, with the recoverable count excluding InspectOnly and NotRecoverable. Familiarity renders as one evidence kind carrying its learned authority; a test asserts the words trust and preferred stay out of the pane. BoundaryReading<T> now generalises the Observed|Unreadable shape (SessionSpaceRoster is a type alias); this was the third fallible boundary call needing nothing-exists kept apart from could-not-ask. THREE NAMED GAPS ARE WHAT REMAINS, all boundary plumbing rather than TUI work: (1) the navigation index installs only Project, Host and Capability records — ResourceKind has Agent, Profile and SkillSet variants but nothing installs them, which blocks Identity and Praxis identically; (2) crates/aikit-tui/src/working_field.rs is pub, exports TerminalWorkingField, SurfaceProjection, PermissionProjection, working_field_from_session_space and select_working_field_subject, and is consumed by NOTHING — W6s whole material is dead because working_field_from_session_space needs a runtime SessionSpaceReadModel and the TUI backend only ACCEPTS one as a parameter, never produces one (no session_space_runtime on PaletteBackend, and aikit-tui does not depend on aikit-adapters where session_space_observation::read() lives); (3) explain_history_service::compare_generation_evidence is still consumed by nothing. Also open: W5 blocked on #227 (Factory Run/Journey status contract), W9/#45 visual and accessibility closure against real screens, W10 physical proving matrix entirely unrun. STILL ACTIONABLE WITHOUT ANY OWNER DECISION: W9 and W10, and a producer for SessionSpaceReadModel would unblock W6 and the working_field module in one move.
